company.summary: CRAMO AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under utleie og leasing av bygge- og anleggsmaskiner og -utstyr (NACE 77.320), based in Oslo, founded 1988-06-16. Registered activity: Utleie av bygg, anleggmasiner og utstyr, samt alt som står i forbindelse hermed, herunder å delta i andre selskap med lignende virksomhet og leie og eie fast eiendom. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 968.8 m, operating result NOK -554.0 k, net result NOK -110.4 m, total assets NOK 2.0 bn, equity NOK 81.1 m. The period closed with a loss. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 980.1 m to NOK 968.8 m (-1%); net result went from NOK -260.7 m to NOK -110.4 m; equity went from NOK 288.6 m to NOK 81.1 m (-72%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -0.1%; equity ratio 4.1%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 288. Leadership in the official register: Börje Mikael Björkholm (managing director); Peter Bernard Marcel Boels (chair of the board); Renaldus Adrianus Cornelis Olsthoorn (board member); Elisabeth Petra Maria Van Kerkom (board member); plus 9 further roles. 29 registered workplaces in Bodø, Brekstad, Eidsnes, Elverum, Fredrikstad, Frogner and more. Official website https://www.cramo.no (identity check: registry declared homepage). Appears to be hiring: 1 active job ad with an exact employer match (Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: website description (not available); company-owned social profiles (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
